summary: This study looks at adults who have previously had a sleeve gastrectomy for obesity and will now undergo a revisional surgery called intestinal transit bipartition. Researchers want to see how this new procedure affects health, metabolism, and how quickly the stomach empties food. The status of the study is Not yet recruiting, with a plan to enroll 40 participants.
